exec: pm.test('createdBy/conductedBy = doctor, 2 pending', function () { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.conductedBy).to.eql(pm.environment.get('doctorId')); pm.expect(r.reviewCounts.pending).to.eql(2); pm.environment.set('roundPublicId', r.publicId); });

exec: pm.test('3 staff, no email or phone', function () {

pm.test('total 2, one item', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.environment.set('firstPatientOnPage0', b.items[0].publicId); });
pm.test('the other patient', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].publicId).to.not.eql(pm.environment.get('firstPatientOnPage0')); });

item.name: Care tasks for ward page 0 size 2 (200)

exec: pm.test('3 tasks, deadline ascending, list fields', function () {
pm.test('the completed order', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });
pm.test('the administered order with nurse and time', function () {

pm.test('one round with review counts', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.items[0].reviewCounts).to.eql({ pending: 2, suspended: 0, resolved: 0 }); });

pm.test('2 reviews with roundPublicId', function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.length).to.eql(2); b.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.roundPublicId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('roundPublicId'))); });
pm.test('the nurse is on duty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.map(a => a.staffId)).to.include(pm.environment.get('nurseId')); });
pm.test('note included', function () { const h = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(h.notes.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(h.notes[0].urgency).to.eql('WATCH'); });

pm.test('this run\'s nurses are listed', function () { const e = pm.response.json().items.map(u => u.email); pm.expect(e).to.include(pm.environment.get('nurseEmail')); pm.expect(e).to.include(pm.environment.get('otherNurseEmail')); });
